entries.zh: 忧惧凶咎、怕遭恶果；敬畏（尊而畏之）
entries.en: to fear ill success/misfortune; to fear with reverence
entries.notes: H 栏此处为西语重文（temer con respeto）而非汉字；L 栏兼含两义，M「畏」与 R「vy」兼摄畏惧、敬畏二义，四栏互证仍清晰

entries.en: to fear with reverence; to stand in awe of
to fear greatly; to dread
entries.notes: R 栏尾段残损（ty. cau le chien le [残]），且疑串入 cau le/chien le 两条对音；释义主要据 L 栏 temer mucho 与 M「惮」字

entries.zh: 惶恐（惊疑不定，不知所措）
entries.en: to be frightened and bewildered; scared, not knowing what to do
entries.notes: R 栏后半夹西语 no sabe lo que…（不知所措），前半 hoyng giony 与 M「惶」字义相合

entries.zh: 疑惧不妙、怕出凶事（栏间难以互证，存疑）
entries.en: to suspect/fear that it will not turn out well (uncertain)
entries.notes: M「悛」与对音「chun」音不合（悛音近 chhoán/quān），疑字有讹或实为「忖」（料想）之误认；释义暂依 L 栏短语 temer no será bueno

entries.en: to fear; to be afraid
to be awed into submission; to submit out of fear
to dread and scruple at; to hold in fearful suspicion
to be terrified; to be alarmed
to be scared and distraught; panic-stricken
to be stunned with fear; aghast
to fear; to be afraid (that)
fear; dread
to fear; to dread
to tremble; to shudder with fear
entries.notes: 「交慄」非通行词形，据「慄」字义与对音 cau le 推断为战栗义，「交」字疑有讹

entries.en: [Original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 四栏互不相合：L 短语残乱（temer do noay & temer），M「有屁」与 R「pa puy」无法与畏惧义对应，疑串行或误写，语义无法定夺

entries.en: to fear getting into trouble; to dread stirring up trouble
entries.notes: L 栏残损（temer el meserpeñalgo. [残]），疑为 meterse en algo（卷入某事）一类短语；释义据 M/R「畏惹事」互证

entries.en: to startle; to be thrown into agitation (alborotarse)
to stand in awe of; to dread (a person or thing)
to shudder; to tremble with fear

entries.zh: 恐惧战栗（如待宰之牲畜，觳觫）
entries.en: to tremble with terror (as an ox led to slaughter)
entries.notes: L 句残损难解（temer como al lioquie: en castigar [残]），对音 han le 与「觳觫」字音不合；释义据 M 栏古典词义（《孟子》「吾不忍其觳觫」，恐惧发抖）
